title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 15
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 15: the Levites carry the ark to David's city with singers, music and great joy.

questions.text: What did David pitch for God's ark in David's city?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 15:1 says David prepared a place for God's ark and pitched a tent for it.

questions.text: According to David, who alone ought to carry God's ark?
questions.explanation: David said, "No one ought to carry God's ark but the Levites," because Yahweh had chosen them to carry it.

questions.text: Which two priests did David call for?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, together with the Levites.

questions.text: What reason did David give for Yahweh breaking out in anger against them the first time?
questions.explanation: David said that because the Levites did not carry it at first, Yahweh broke out against them, because they did not seek him according to the ordinance.

answers.text: They had left the ark in Kiriath Jearim too long
The Philistines had touched the ark
They didn't seek him according to the ordinance

questions.text: How did the children of the Levites bear God's ark?
questions.explanation: The Levites bore God's ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to Yahweh's word.

answers.text: On their shoulders with its poles
On a new cart pulled by oxen

questions.text: What were the singers Heman, Asaph and Ethan given to sound aloud?
questions.explanation: Verse 19 says the singers Heman, Asaph and Ethan were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud.

questions.text: Why did Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, teach the singers?
questions.explanation: Chenaniah was over the singing and taught the singers because he was skillful.

questions.text: What did they sacrifice when God helped the Levites who bore the ark?
questions.explanation: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

questions.text: Besides a robe of fine linen, what did David have on him?
questions.explanation: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and he had an ephod of linen on him.

questions.text: How did Michal the daughter of Saul react when she saw King David dancing and playing?
questions.explanation: Michal looked out at the window, saw king David dancing and playing, and despised him in her heart.

answers.text: She despised him in her heart
